description: Source code for Http2DecoderAdapter class implementing HTTP/2 frame decoding and handling, including error management, frame parsing, and interaction with visitor interfaces within the quiche/spdy/http2 protocol stack.

classes.name: Http2DecoderAdapter
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding HTTP/2 frames, managing decoding state, error handling, and delegating events to visitor interfaces.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data buffer, decoding frames until all data is consumed or an error occurs.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Handles the event when a frame header has been decoded, validating and dispatching based on frame type.

methods.name: OnDataStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a DATA frame.

methods.name: OnDataPayload
methods.description: Handles payload data of a DATA frame.

methods.name: OnDataEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a DATA frame.

methods.name: OnHeadersStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a HEADERS frame.

methods.name: OnHpackFragment
methods.description: Handles fragments of HPACK-encoded header blocks.

methods.name: OnContinuationStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a CONTINUATION frame.

methods.name: OnContinuationEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a CONTINUATION frame.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Handles the start of SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: OnGoAwayOpaqueData
methods.description: Handles opaque data in GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: OnAltSvcOriginData
methods.description: Handles origin data in ALTSVC frame.

methods.name: OnAltSvcValueData
methods.description: Handles value data in ALTSVC frame.

methods.name: OnUnknownStart
methods.description: Handles start of unknown frame types.

methods.name: OnPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Handles error when padding length exceeds frame payload.

methods.name: ProcessInputFrame
methods.description: Decodes a single frame from input data buffer.

methods.name: DetermineSpdyState
methods.description: Determines the next decoding state based on current decode status.

methods.name: ResetBetweenFrames
methods.description: Resets internal state between frame decodings.

methods.name: SetSpdyErrorAndNotify
methods.description: Sets error state and notifies visitor.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if current state is error.

methods.name: IsReadingPaddingLength
methods.description: Checks if currently reading padding length.

methods.name: IsOkToStartFrame
methods.description: Validates if frame can be started based on current state and frame header.

methods.name: HasRequiredStreamId
methods.description: Validates if stream ID meets requirements.

methods.name: HasRequiredStreamIdZero
methods.description: Validates if stream ID is zero as required.

methods.name: ReportReceiveCompressedFrame
methods.description: Reports reception of compressed frame to debug interface.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoder
methods.description: Returns or creates HPACK decoder instance.

methods.name: CommonStartHpackBlock
methods.description: Begins HPACK header block decoding process.

methods.name: MaybeAnnounceEmptyFirstHpackFragment
methods.description: Ensures HPACK fragment is announced even if empty.
